# BOSS

> The team you hire, just in time. BOSS runs inside Claude Code: builders, mentors, and a conscience that says one thing when you drift. Free, MIT, local.

BOSS (Build Out Solid Stuff) is a zero-dependency CLI plus Claude Code skills, agents and hooks for founders. It sets a project up with only the structure it has earned, grows it through four modes (Quickstart → MVP → V1 → Scale), and says one thing when the founder drifts. Everything stays on the founder's machine. MIT licensed, free, v0.327.0. Install: `npm install -g oyeboss` or `brew install ajeshh/boss/oyeboss`; needs Node 18+ and Claude Code.

## Pages

- [About — the person who built this](https://oyeboss.build/about): BOSS was built by Ajesh Shah, who has spent almost two decades building in different capacities, from five-person teams to the Fortune 500, around one method: scaffolding.
- [The Humane Product Canvas — free, yours, no install](https://oyeboss.build/canvas): A one-page canvas for pressure-testing an idea as a humane business. Starts from the Business Model Canvas, asks what the humane version would. Free, CC BY-SA.
- [Charter — a conscience, not a censor](https://oyeboss.build/charter): The humane line BOSS holds itself to: name the cost, hand the decision back, never remove the option. The mechanism, and the honest limits.
- [The conscience — how it decides to speak](https://oyeboss.build/conscience): BOSS's core mechanism: a hook watches the state of the work, a model composes the voice, and it hands the decision back. Overridable, never blocking.
- [Credits — everyone BOSS learned from](https://oyeboss.build/credits): BOSS is a distillation of other people's published thinking. This is the roll call: the practitioners, labs, papers and specs behind every practice it ships.
- [The demo — one venture, every piece, generated](https://oyeboss.build/demo): Kettlewick, a fictional home-care venture run through BOSS end to end: playbook, design space, board and files, made by the same code an install runs.
- [Design — how BOSS approaches UI and UX](https://oyeboss.build/design): What goes wrong by default when AI writes your interface, the token discipline that prevents it, and the line between persuasion and manipulation.
- [For engineers — how BOSS approaches agentic development](https://oyeboss.build/engineering): The technical positions BOSS actually holds on harnesses, context, agent security, testing and retrieval — and, for each one, who it learned that from.
- [Governance — how BOSS decides what it believes](https://oyeboss.build/governance): Every practice BOSS ships is attributed, dated, and has a review trigger. Here's the pipeline an outside claim has to survive, and how staleness gets caught.
- [Guide — using the team, rung by rung](https://oyeboss.build/guide): What each mode adds, when to unlock, what happens after you ship, and how it works with a cofounder.
- [BOSS — Claude Code skills, agents and a conscience for founders](https://oyeboss.build/): The team you hire, just in time. BOSS runs inside Claude Code: builders, mentors, and a conscience that says one thing when you drift. Free, MIT, local.
- [Keeping track — what BOSS writes down, so you don't have to](https://oyeboss.build/keeping-track): Twelve ideas, three half-finished specs, a decision you can't remember making. BOSS gives each a file, a status and a place, and renders the board from them.
- [The playbook — your records, read back as the company](https://oyeboss.build/playbook): boss playbook turns your records — idea, people, evidence, decisions, brand — into sixteen chapters. Press Present for a deck, VC or internal cut; export PDF.
- [For product people — the positions BOSS holds](https://oyeboss.build/product): Ceremony scaled to evidence, a canvas that is an answer store not a framework, an evidence ladder that grades what people did, and a roadmap with a no-list.
- [For project management — progress you can't fake](https://oyeboss.build/project): A board derived from files, never maintained; a closed status vocabulary; parked work with a written re-open trigger; decisions that say what proves them wrong.
- [Start — your first hour with BOSS](https://oyeboss.build/start): Install, then either start something new or bring BOSS into a repo you already have. Both paths, the real output, and how to take it back out.
- [The team — who BOSS hires, and when](https://oyeboss.build/team): BOSS staffs your project. Builders who make the thing, mentors who coach you — and they arrive just in time, as the project earns them.
- [What BOSS refuses to do, and what would prove it wrong](https://oyeboss.build/thinking): What BOSS will not do to you — no scoring, no notifications while you're away, no assuming a company — each a decision with its cost and its falsifier.
- [What's new in BOSS](https://oyeboss.build/whats-new): The releases that change what you do, generated from the same changelog `boss sync` reads to tell your project what changed since its pin.
